items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Erwin Leclair has moved out to Jefferson Parish now. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Erwin Leclair? Yes he is.

ctx.x: Erwin Leclair has moved out to Jefferson Parish now. No, Orvin's not living.
Last time I talked to him he was alive. Well I'll be damned. Tell him hello for me.
